newsitem.title: CHILE: Cemetery firm repays debt to Banco Edwards.
newsitem.headline: Cemetery firm repays debt to Banco Edwards.

text.p: Chile's Banco de A. Edwards said it has been repaid loans and interest totalling $11.1 million made to failed cemetery company Isacruz.
But the bank's consumer credit division, Finandes, still holds promissory notes worth $14.3 million on burial plots bought by Isacruz clients, said the bank in a statement.
"In management's opinion, the bank's provision for loan losses adequately covers potential losses the bank might incur with respect to such promissory notes," it said.
Isacruz, which was recently declared bankrupt, was one of a number of problem debtors suffered by the bank last year.
